IncidentBot: [INC-2026-00321] P1 - MeridianBank (VPC) auth failures detected; paging oncall.rebecca and #incidents. Root cause unknown. Alert: high 401 rate from tenant meridianbank-prod since 2026-03-15T08:12:00Z. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-00321 :rotating_light:
rebecca: oncall here, looking. seeing the page. @diana (cust) can you confirm any key rotations on your side?
raj: I pulled the auth logs from the VPC edge. Lots of 401s with same error: \"token validation failed: kid \"abc123\" not found in JWK set\". Appears to be signing key mismatch when verifying JWTs for meridianbank-prod.
rebecca: ok. is this isolated to meridianbank or broader?
raj: isolated to that tenant's dedicated pool. Other tenants ok.
diana (meridianbank-sre): confirming — we rotated signing keys yesterday night as part of a scheduled rotation. We thought the new JWKS published at https://id.meridianbank.com/.well-known/jwks.json would cover it. We didn't get any errors on our side.
rebecca: can you paste the jwks_uri response? quick check please.
diana (meridianbank-sre): sure, one sec.
rebecca: in the meantime, raj — can you try curling the issuer discovery from our runtime? show what our fetch sees.
raj: running from control-plane subnet now.
raj: ```
$ curl -i https://id.meridianbank.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "issuer": "https://id.meridianbank.com",
  "jwks_uri": "https://id.meridianbank.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
}

$ curl -i https://id.meridianbank.com/.well-known/jwks.json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "keys": [ { "kty":"RSA", "kid":"def456", ... } ]
}
```
raj: The returned JWKS only contains kid def456 (new key). Our runtime is trying to validate tokens signed with kid abc123 (old key) — apparently some tokens still in circulation signed by old key. Our runtime caches the tenant JWKS (TTL=12h) but it only has the current set from discovery — it never saw abc123, so validation fails.
rebecca: that explains it — tokens minted before rotation still signed by old key. We need a quick mitigation so the customer can accept pre-rotation tokens while they refresh everything.
diana (meridianbank-sre): we can re-enable the old key in our JWKS if needed, but it has been deleted from our key store. recovering it will take time. any other options?
alex: we have an administrative per-tenant override in the control plane that allows us to inject a supplemental JWKS entry for a tenant for a short window. It's not ideal but it's a standard emergency flow. Requires security sign-off and will be fully audited.
anna correction: whoops, I'm anna (security) — I'm on it. as long as customer verbally confirms ownership of key material, we can do a temporary JWKS add with a 30m TTL. We'll require the customer to provide the old public key fingerprint and rotation timeline.
rebecca: tagging @diana for verification. Diana, can you provide the old key's public modulus/fingerprint or the full jwk for abc123?
diana (meridianbank-sre): we don't have the old private key, but we have an exported public JWK from our backup: {"kty":"RSA","kid":"abc123","n":"...","e":"AQAB"}. Sending via secure artifact: https://securefiles.meridianbank/safe/old-jwks.json (internal to customer).
anna (security): ok that works. security approves temporary injection for 30 minutes with immediate audit logging and postmortem. Please include customer SRE in the ticket and rotate keys properly afterwards.
rebecca: proceeding to inject supplemental JWKS. Command (control-plane admin):
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/meridianbank/jwks-override
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "override_jwks": { "keys": [ { "kty":"RSA", "kid":"abc123", "n":"...", "e":"AQAB" } ] },
  "expires_in": 1800  // seconds
}
```
rebecca: executing now...
ops-bot: action initiated by rebecca: applying jwks override to tenant meridianbank-prod (request id r-8f3a2).
rebecca: applied. ops-bot returned 200.
ops-bot: audit log created: https://audit.redwood.internal/r-8f3a2 (sensitive content redacted).
raj: re-checking auth logs and request success rates.
raj: good signal — 200s recover from 08:21:12Z for meridianbank-prod, 401 rate drops to baseline.
diana (meridianbank-sre): seeing successful responses on our side now. thank you! :tada:
rebecca: leaving note in thread: temporary JWKS injected for 30m. Customer to publish updated JWKS with both keys (or re-issue tokens) and confirm, then we'll remove override.
anna (security): verify customer rotation plan and timeline in post-incident review. Also suggest we add finer-grained monitoring for JWKS mismatch errors in the future.
rebecca: creating incident ticket and scheduling handoff. I'm around for another 20m then handing to alex for daytime oncall. alex — can you pick this up and make sure override is removed when customer confirms?
alex: yup will take. I'll monitor and do the removal once diana confirms. Also will add runbook step to check cache invalidation TTL for tenant JWKS.
diana (meridianbank-sre): we'll publish a JWKS that contains both abc123 and def456 within 15m and then confirm here.
diana (meridianbank-sre): update — published combined JWKS at https://id.meridianbank.com/.well-known/jwks.json (contains abc123 + def456). Confirmed with curl from our side.
raj: pulling discovery now shows both keys.
raj: verified. proceeding to remove override in 5m after customer says stable.
alex: removing override in 5...4...3...
ops-bot: action initiated by alex: remove jwks override for meridianbank-prod (request id r-8f3a2-cleanup).
ops-bot: override removed, audit log: https://audit.redwood.internal/r-8f3a2-cleanup.
raj: traffic still normal, 200s steady.
diana (meridianbank-sre): all good here. thanks everyone. appreciate the fast help.
rebecca: handing off to alex for follow-ups (postmortem, runbook updates, check TTLs). I'll add notes to INC-2026-00321 and close after postmortem. :thumbsup:
alex: ack. I'll own the follow-up tasks: 1) update runbook to include JWKS rotation checklist; 2) add alert rule for repeated \"kid not found\" errors per tenant; 3) review control-plane JWKS cache TTL behavior.
rebecca: closing notes: incident mitigated via temporary per-tenant JWKS injection; root cause customer key rotation caused token verification mismatch for pre-rotation tokens; impact limited to meridianbank-prod dedicated pool (tenant isolation worked); no other tenants impacted. Follow-ups assigned to alex and security.
IncidentBot: INC-2026-00321 status -> mitigated. Postmortem required (assigned: alex).
alex: will share postmortem draft in #postmortems and tag the customer success lead for comms.
rebecca: thanks all, nice work. :clap:
